name: Psion
description: Psionically trained travellers who develop and apply mental talents outside ordinary career structures.

adept.name: Adept
adept.description: You train and use psionic talents.

mishaps.1: Psionic strain injures you. Roll on the Injury table.
mishaps.2: Your institute is exposed or attacked. Gain an Enemy and leave this career.
mishaps.4: You are forced into hiding. Gain Stealth 1 and leave this career.
mishaps.5: You become involved in illegal work. Gain Deception 1 and a Rival.
mishaps.6: A dangerous experiment scars you. Roll on the Injury table.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table.
events.3: You encounter hostile authorities. Gain an Enemy.
events.4: You assist another psion. Gain a Contact.
events.6: You are given advanced training. Gain one psionic talent skill.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.8: You develop discipline. Gain DM+2 to your next advancement check.
events.9: You make useful allies. Gain an Ally.
events.11: You are recognised by your peers. Gain DM+2 to any one Benefit roll.
events.12: You make a breakthrough. You are automatically promoted.
